g.text: Mini Udemy - Sınıf diyagramı: DTO + Mapper (MapStruct) —
entity → DTO dönüşümü yalnız mapper'da, MapStruct
uygulamayı derlemede üretir. Eşlenmemiş hedef alan
Mapper'ı yalnız aynı modülün service'i kullanır
+toSummary(course : Course, instructor : UserSummary, stats : CourseStats) : CourseSummaryResponse
+toDetail(course : Course, instructor : UserSummary, stats : CourseStats, sections : List<SectionResponse>) : CourseDetailResponse
+toStats(courseId : Long, enrollmentCount : long, averageProgressPercent : double, completionRate : double, quizzes : List<QuizStats>, rating : RatingStats) : CourseStatsResponse
+toRatingStats(averageRating : Double, reviewCount : long, distribution : Map<String, Long>) : RatingStats
+toStudent(entry : RosterEntry, student : UserSummary, quizResults : List<QuizBestResult>) : CourseStudentResponse
+toResponse(enrollment : Enrollment, course : CourseSummaryResponse, progressPercent : double, lastLessonId : Long, lastAccessedAt : Instant) : EnrollmentResponse
